about.intro: I build websites for small businesses and local associations, from Rountzenheim, in Alsace.

story.title: Who I am
story.p1: I come from Rountzenheim, a village in northern Alsace. I trained in industrial automation — systems that run production lines and are not allowed to stop — then earned my engineering degree in digital solutions at Icam Strasbourg-Europe, as an apprentice at ERAS. That is where I learned to build things that have to work every day, not just on demo day.
story.p2: It all started with my chess club in Bischwiller. Its website was more than fifteen years old. I rebuilt it completely: new design, content carried over, domain name and hosting — and above all, I trained the volunteers so they could publish their own news. Today the club keeps its website alive without me.
story.p3: That project made me want to turn this into my job. I created RK.ai to bring the same thing to small businesses and associations around here: a clear website that looks like them, and that they can keep alive themselves.

items.title: No jargon
items.text: I explain what I do and why, in plain words. You always know what you are paying for.

items.title: You stay independent
items.text: I train your team or your volunteers to publish without me, just like I did with the chess club.

items.q: How much does a custom website cost?
items.a: Every project is unique: the budget depends on the scope (showcase, e-commerce, application), design and features. After a free initial call, you receive a detailed, transparent quote — no surprises.
Allow 2 to 3 weeks for a showcase site and 4 to 6 weeks for an e-commerce or an application. You follow the progress continuously with regular check-ins and demo versions.

items.q: Will my site rank well on Google?
items.a: Technical SEO is included in every project: semantic structure, loading speed, meta tags, sitemap and structured data. Near-perfect Lighthouse scores are a standard, not an option.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
items.a: Yes. Maintenance plans cover updates, security, backups and evolutions. You stay focused on your business, I take care of the tech.
